notes.title: News from the development fields # 1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello to "snake" lovers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34048618/48af7442f8419b6b485f4c19babb5b9c669fd29a.png[/img]

Today we want to present the current list of achievements which you can unlock during the passage of the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34048618/c9615e4c9579b86d95520070be8ee24b28935533.gif[/img]

When developing the list, we wanted to cover as wide a circle of players as possible and tried to make achievements interesting for everyone to discover. At the moment, the game has 37 achievements. We hope that you will be satisfied with them during the passage of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34048618/d972633541cf72bf9d766f9e70ebd301ad725f46.png[/img]

Thank you for taking the time to read this short note. Very soon we will tell you much more interesting news with a lot of useful information.

Best regards, team Space Raccoon Game Studio

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
